stage.need: Memory around ages 5 to 6. CDC 5 years: 'Tells a story she heard or made up with at least two events', 'Answers simple questions about a book or story after you read or tell it to him', and the tip 'Play games that help with memory and attention. For example, play card games, Tic Tac Toe, I Spy, or Hot and Cold.'; CDC 4 years: 'Tells what comes next in a well-known story'. Games give a reason to hold something in mind for a few seconds, books give a story to retell.
stage.age_caveat: Ages are approximate: CDC milestones are what most children do by an age, not a deadline. Some 5 year olds retell a whole story and some need more time; the frame says בסביבות and the caption says יש ילדים ש....
